interpretation_issues.observation: Article 7 covers expression, Braille, sign language, other communication means and information; Article 20(2) lists electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review.

interpretation_issues.observation: Article 23 requires the competent authorities to set engineering standards and a Cabinet decision to issue controls and exemptions.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved.

interpretation_issues.observation: The Law, the 2018 Cabinet Resolution and the 2024 policy address different aspects of disability inclusion and digital accessibility.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading.

interpretation_issues.observation: The UAE Legislation platform provides an English translation and states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; Arabic prevails and native legal review is outstanding.
